comment: Shared expectations for record metadata inference and record discovery.
gbdraw/core/record_metadata.py owns this inference for the Pyodide Worker and the renderer.
gbdraw/web/js/services/record-discovery.js reimplements it for the no-Worker upload fast path.
file, so the two implementations cannot drift apart unnoticed.
discovery: small synthetic inputs. The gbdraw.io.genome loader is the oracle for expected;
tests/test_record_metadata.py checks the loader and the Worker helper, and the Node test checks
that the fast path returns expected or declines to the Worker (Web GUI audit 2026-09-30, G-D).
tests/web/gui-audit-20260930-inputs.playwright.spec.js reads the multi-organism case for the Linear per-record definition check (IN-06).
definition: lineage is the first word of the record's lineage (absent: none, as for GFF3 input);
lines are split_organism_lines' Circular lines (taxon, strain), which only the Python test reads.
The definition cases from 'no name' on are the Auto name rule's examples the Owner approved (2026-10-25).
A discovery case with "fastPath": "declines" is one the fast path leaves to the Worker; the Node test expects one Worker call.
